notes.title: Demo: QoL Update
notes.notes:
Some animation bugs have been added in the last update that had to be fixed. In addition, I improved the display of character's skill. It's now much easier to quickly check what skills a character has in battle.

Changelog:

 Fixed a bug that made the attack animation to sometimes play two times in a row.
 Added 1 shield to Raniac's quest (it's slightly easier now).
 Right mouse button now unselects a character.
 Fixed an issue that made the characters sometimes look at a different direction at the end of cutscenes.
 Fixed an issue that made the displayed duration of a map incorrect before the fight begins.
 Improved the look of the character's skills bar
 Added skill icons above health bars
 Added Raniac's portrait
 Prevented recruitable characters to spawn until you have enough coins to recruit them

notes.title: Demo: Character Rework Update
notes.notes:
New character portraits are here to replace the AI placeholders! This lead to a rework of the character models to match the new portraits, and add way more details. For now, only the playable characters are using the reworked character visuals, but we will be extending this to all characters in a near future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108365/8a71c1306155cff00a953a78886b1a7c226cd5a3.jpg

In addition, we added a new quest for about 30min of new content! This quest is still work in progress, but it already introduce you to the beginning of the main story line.

Our road map looks a bit awkward, as we added half of element 2 and element 3. In the near future, we will thus finish and polish the character and the new quest, to complete the demo:
✔️ Make the World Map.
⚒️ Make the final character portraits & update the character 3D models accordingly (they are going to look amazing!).
⚒️ Add a few quests to introduce the main story and add more content.

notes.title: Demo: World Map Update
notes.notes:
The new world map is here! Until then the game used an AI generated image as a placeholder.
The map is semi 3D to add a feeling of depth and make it feels more alive. I also painted new icons, and added sound effects. It now has dense clouds all around it to hide content that will be revealed in the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108365/cd4473519097fc017605903f29899a184437484c.jpg

It's the first of the 3 major updates to be done on this demo (after that not much will change until the release of the full game):

✔️ Make the World Map.
Make the final character portraits & update the character 3D models accordingly (they are going to look amazing!).
Add a few quests to introduce the main story and add more content.


If you want to learn more about the development of Fauneroes, you can join the Discord Server. We would love to have a chat with you!
